title: Legal Receptionist
description:
Our client a boutique law firm specializing in tax, estate, and business planning is seeking a full-time receptionist to join their team in Haddonfield, NJ.
Ideal candidate will be poised, punctual, and professional with a welcoming friendly demeanor.

Schedule:
Monday–Friday, 8:15 AM–5:00 PM (in-office) with one hour lunch.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Open and close office: lights, doors, elevator, and tidy common areas
  • Greet and seat clients and visitors with warmth and professionalism
  • Answer a computerized phone system, route incoming calls; take clear, accurate messages
  • Receive, sort, stamp, scan, and distribute mail and deliveries
  • Maintain and circulate daily office attendance list
  • Book and manage conference room schedules
  • Monitor and forward incoming e-faxes
  • Calendaring using Practice Master (will train)
  • Support the Firm Administrator with additional tasks as needed
Ideal Candidate:
  • Exceptionally reliable and punctual
  • Polished, well-groomed, and professional in demeanor
  • Excellent verbal communication and phone etiquette
  • Comfortable managing multiple tasks with attention to detail
  • Able to maintain discretion and confidentiality
  • MS Office experience, Word and Outlook
Compensation & Benefits:
  • Salary range of $45k-$55k, depending on experience
  • Paid time off (PTO)
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) plan (after one year of full-time employment)

title: admin/bookkeeper
description:
Our industrial supply/manufacturing company located in the northern suburbs is looking to hire an Office Clerk due to growth within the organization.  They are seeking a reliable and extremely detail-oriented individual to join the company. The ideal person will play a vital role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day operations of the office by performing administrative, clerical, and customer support duties. This position requires strong organizational skills, a proactive attitude, and the ability to work efficiently with others in a fast-paced environment.
  • Salary - $18-$20 an hour
  • Schedule - 8 to 4:30 M-F in office
  • Benefits - medical, dental, vision, profit sharing after 1 year with the company, PTO (2 weeks to start and then 1 day additional each year with a max of 20 days)
Responsibilities:
  1. Administrative Support
    • Maintain and update office records, files, and databases.
    • Prepare and process invoices, purchase orders, and shipping documents.
    • Answer and direct phone calls, emails, and other inquiries.
  2. Inventory and Supply Management
    • Confirm & check status of PO’s.
    • Assist in tracking incoming and outgoing shipments, and items not received
    • Assist in paying of invoices and collection items from customers.
  3. Data Entry and Reporting
    • Input and update customer, supplier, and order data accurately.
    • Generate reports for management on sales, inventory, and other metrics.
    • Verify the accuracy of data and documents before processing.
  4. Clerical Duties
    • Handle incoming and outgoing mail, including courier deliveries.
    • Maintain cleanliness and organization of the office area
 
Qualifications:
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
  • Attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience with inventory or order management systems preferred.

title: Office/Business Manager
description:
Our client in Plymouth Meeting is looking for an Office/Business Manager to support their team. This is a Direct Hire, On site position that pays up to 80k with FULLY PAID benefits for the individual and their family!
This person must enjoy working alone or in a small group and have excellent accounting and administrative acumen and strong attention to detail. (Benefits listed below)

Candidates must have a strong accounting/bookkeeping and administrative background.

Summary Description:

This individual is responsible for maintaining the administrative offices to ensure that the office runs efficiently and effectively.

This person performs payroll, accounts receivable/payable functions, human resources, and communicates with regulatory agencies, engineers, vendors, and the public, as needed.

Major Duties:

 Acts as receptionist to the public and vendors.

 Receives and directs all incoming correspondence and communications.

 Processes payroll using Sage Software to include bi-weekly payroll taxes.

 Completes quarterly payroll taxes.

 Works with Auditor to complete the annual audit.

 Assist Executive Director with annual budget.

 Prepares accounts payable checks, cross checking purchase orders with the packing slips and bills, compiling monthly bill lists, preparing checks and spreadsheet.

 Prepares accounts receivable by invoicing townships and Aqua for quarterly billing.

 Prepares monthly bill sheet and statement of accounts for the monthly board meeting.

 Monthly bank reconciliation.

 Reconcile monthly credit cards.

 Enrolls new hires in Health Insurance, long term disability Insurance (LTD) and short term disability Insurance (STD). Files initial STD & LTD claims with the insurance

company.

 Enroll employees in pension plans.

 Ensures bond reporting compliance.

 Administers all correspondence, reports, spreadsheets. Research, complete and assist in administrative projects assigned by the Executive Director.

 Creates and/or maintains all project and administrative files and documents.

 Coordinates monthly meetings including advertising and assembling supporting documents for the agenda.

 Maintains HR files and other confidential records

 Administer all non-operational contracts, such as uniforms and bottled water service.

 Orders office supplies, make bank deposits, withdrawals, and picks up supplies, if necessary.

 Any other tasks assigned by the Executive Director.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

 Working knowledge of bookkeeping practices and procedures.

 Experience Excel, and Word.

 Experience with accounting software.

 Ability to effectively communicate with tact and diplomacy with other employees and outside agencies

Education/Experience/Training:

 High School diploma. Five years' office and administrative experience.

 Any equivalent combination of education, training and experience that provides the required knowledge, skills and abilities.

Benefits:

  • Twelve sick days per year, pro-rated from date of hire;
  • Ten paid holidays per year;
  • Five vacation days for the first six months of employment, ten days after six months and for the next five years.
  • Five personal days per year, prorated from date of hire.
  • Life insurance in the amount of $100,000;
  • Healthcare U.S. Healthcare – Premier Plan major medical, prescription, and vision coverage for employee and eligible dependents;
  • Delta Dental Service Plan for dental and orthodontic coverage for employee and eligible dependents; and,
  • An optional 457 Deferred Compensation Plan with a 50% match up to $50 per pay.
